annotation.evidence_span: total number of QUIC packets sent with an ECT codepoint that are newly acknowledged
annotation.interpretation_a: The count applies to packets *fully* acknowledged in this frame (i.e., all segments within the packet are acknowledged).
annotation.interpretation_b: The count applies to packets where *any* segment within the packet is newly acknowledged in this frame, even if other segments were already acknowledged.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'newly acknowledged' is ambiguous. Does it mean the entire packet must be newly acknowledged, or is it sufficient that at least one segment within the packet is newly acknowledged? This difference impacts the calculation of the total number of packets to compare against the ECN counts.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether 'newly acknowledged' refers to the entire packet or any segment within the packet. This affects how the count is calculated.
